'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
